rationale: Latest stable production-compatible stack for the current TGM Alarm Center architecture. Expo SDK 57.0.17 includes React Native 0.86.3 fixes; Node 24.20.0 is the current LTS; TypeScript 7.0.2 and ESLint 10.9.1 are current stable toolchain releases. Android API 36, iOS 16.4+, and Hermes V1 remain aligned with Expo SDK 57.
